zh_cn.title: 解析水晶
zh_cn.text: 检视水晶，需要将 真理水晶 持有在副手。使用后，会在聊天栏将真理水晶中存储的详细题目描述展示出来。

en_us.title: Crystal Analysis
en_us.text: Crystal Gazing requires a Truth Crystal held in the offhand. It consumes no media and displays the detailed information stored within the crystal in chat. Takes no input and produces no output.

zh_cn.title: 所在之精思 (→ biome)
zh_cn.text:
返回施法者当前所处群系的 群系Iota 。有时会遇到事故
该页面不是Minecraft的官方产品，不隶属于Mojang和Microsoft，且不代表Mojang和Microsoft的意见。
Minecraft的游戏内容和资源均为各自所有者的知识财产。
使用 hexdoc 精心制作。❤️

en_us.title: Current Whereabouts (→ biome)
en_us.text:
Returns a Biome Token of the biome the caster currently stands in. Sometimes mishaps happen.
Not an official Minecraft product. Not approved by or associated with Mojang or Microsoft.
Minecraft content and materials are the intellectual property of their respective owners.
Made with ❤️ using hexdoc .

zh_cn.title: 探古寻迹 (vector, biome|structure →)
zh_cn.text: 接受一个 群系Iota ，召唤一枚飞向目标群系或结构的探古之眼，消耗一份充能紫水晶。

en_us.title: Locate (vector, biome|structure →)
en_us.text: Takes a Biome Token and summons an Eye of Locating that flies toward the target biome or structure. Costs a charged amethyst.

zh_cn.title: 随缘之精思 (→ biome|structure)
zh_cn.text: 有半数概率随机挑选一个群系，另一半概率挑选一个结构，封装为 Iota 返回。与探古寻迹配合，可开启一场随缘的探索之旅。

en_us.title: Random Target (→ biome|structure)
en_us.text: With equal odds it picks a random biome or a random structure, returning it wrapped as a Biome Token . Paired with Locate, it begins a journey of serendipity.

zh_cn.title: 忒弥斯之纯化 (list → list)
zh_cn.text: 真理水晶自身要求输出顺序严格。此图案接受一个列表，将其内部元素按某种内在顺序重排并返回排序后的列表。

en_us.title: Themistian Purification (list → list)
en_us.text: Truth Crystals demand strict output ordering. This pattern takes a list, rearranges its elements according to an intrinsic ordering, and returns the sorted list.

zh_cn.title: 召唤追踪之眼 (vector, entity →)
zh_cn.text: 接受一个 向量 （召唤位置）与一个 实体 （目标），在该位置召唤一只以那个实体为目标的 追踪之眼 ，消耗一枚充能紫水晶

en_us.title: Summon Tracking Eye (vector, entity →)
en_us.text: Takes a vector (summon position) and an entity (target); summons an Eye of Tracking at that position, which takes that entity as its target. Costs a charged amethyst.

zh_cn.title: 召唤路标之眼 (vector, vector →)
zh_cn.text: 接受两个 向量 （召唤位置与目的地），在该位置召唤一只飞向目的地坐标的 路标之眼 ，消耗一份紫水晶粉

en_us.title: Summon Waypoint Eye (vector, vector →)
en_us.text: Takes two vectors (summon position and destination); summons an Eye of Waypoint at that position, which flies to the destination coordinates. Costs amethyst dust.

names.zh_cn: 树木学家之纯化，第二型

names.ja_jp: ディオスクロイの仕掛

zh_cn.title: 狄俄斯库里之策略 (any, any → any, any, any, any)
zh_cn.text: 复制栈顶的两个 iota。[0, 1] 变为 [0, 1, 0, 1]。

en_us.title: Dioscuri Gambit (any, any → any, any, any, any)
en_us.text: Copy the top two iotas of the stack. [0, 1] becomes [0, 1, 0, 1].

zh_cn.title: 长度之纯化 (list → num)
zh_cn.text: Remove the list at the top of the stack, then push the number of elements in the list to the stack.

en_us.title: Length Purification (list → num)
en_us.text: Remove the list at the top of the stack, then push the number of elements in the list to the stack.

zh_cn.title: 加法之馏化 (list, list → list)
zh_cn.text: Remove the list at the top of the stack, then add all its elements to the end of the list at the top of the stack.

en_us.title: Additive Distillation (list, list → list)
en_us.text: Remove the list at the top of the stack, then add all its elements to the end of the list at the top of the stack.

zh_cn.title: 驱动 (entity, vector →)
zh_cn.text: 移除栈顶的实体和表示方向的向量，然后将所给实体沿所给方向推动出去。驱动力的强度由向量的模长决定。 消耗向量模长的平方个 紫水晶粉 。除对某实体第一次使用外，其他情况额外消耗 1 个。

en_us.title: Impulse (entity, vector →)
en_us.text: Remove an entity and direction from the stack, then give a shove to the given entity in the given direction. The strength of the impulse is determined by the length of the vector. Costs units of Amethyst Dust equal to the square of the length of the vector, plus one for every Impulse except the first targeting an entity.

zh_cn.title: 阿卡夏之馏化 (vector, pattern → any)
zh_cn.text: 在 阿卡夏记录 处从 阿卡夏图书馆 中读出所给图案对应的 iota。没有读取距离限制。消耗大约 1 个 紫水晶粉 。

en_us.title: Akasha's Distillation (vector, pattern → any)
en_us.text: Read the iota associated with the given pattern out of the Akashic Library with its Record at the given position. This has no range limit. Costs about one Amethyst Dust .

zh_cn.title: 阿卡夏之策略 (vector, pattern, any →)
zh_cn.text:
在 阿卡夏图书馆 的 记录 处将 iota 和所给图案对应起来。 有 存储距离限制。消耗大约 1 个 紫水晶粉 。
能以魔法影响到世界的图案和操作。

en_us.title: Akasha's Gambit (vector, pattern, any →)
en_us.text:
Associate the iota with the given pattern in the Akashic Library with its Record at the given position. This does have a range limit. Costs about one Amethyst Dust .
Patterns and actions that perform a magical effect on the world.

zh_cn.title: 合取之馏化 ((num, num)|(list, list) → num|list)
zh_cn.text:
取两集合的交集。
操作如下：
若栈顶为两个数，将其组合为仅在两个位组中 均 为 1 处为 1 的位组。
若栈顶为两个列表，则创建一个由第一个和第二个列表共有的元素组成的列表。

en_us.title: Conjunction Distillation ((num, num)|(list, list) → num|list)
en_us.text:
Takes the intersection of two sets.
As such:
With two numbers at the top of the stack, combines them into a bitset containing every on bit present in both bitsets.
With two lists, this creates a list of every element from the first list that is also in the second list.

zh_cn.title: 整合之馏化 (list, any → list)
zh_cn.text: 移除栈顶元素，将其加到栈顶列表的末尾。

en_us.title: Integration Distillation (list, any → list)
en_us.text: Remove the top of the stack, then add it to the end of the list at the top of the stack.

zh_cn.title: 反余弦之纯化 (num → num)
zh_cn.text: 计算所给数（绝对值小于 1）的反余弦，也即余弦为该值的角。与 π 和 τ 的值有关。

en_us.title: Inverse Cosine Prfn. (num → num)
en_us.text: Takes the inverse cosine of a value with absolute value 1 or less, yielding the angle whose cosine is that value. Related to the values of π and τ .

zh_cn.title: 反正弦之纯化 (num → num)
zh_cn.text: 计算所给数（绝对值小于 1）的反正弦，也即正弦为该值的角。与 π 和 τ 的值有关。

en_us.title: Inverse Sine Prfn. (num → num)
en_us.text: Takes the inverse sine of a value with absolute value 1 or less, yielding the angle whose sine is that value. Related to the values of π and τ .

zh_cn.title: 反正切之纯化 (num → num)
zh_cn.text: 计算所给数的反正切，也即正切为该值的角。与 π 和 τ 的值有关。

en_us.title: Inverse Tangent Prfn. (num → num)
en_us.text: Takes the inverse tangent of a value, yielding the angle whose tangent is that value. Related to the values of π and τ .

zh_cn.title: 反正切之纯化，第二型 (num, num → num)
zh_cn.text: 计算所给纵坐标与横坐标的反正切，也即计算 X 轴正向，与原点至所给坐标的射线间的夹角。

en_us.title: Inverse Tan. Prfn. II (num, num → num)
en_us.text: Takes the inverse tangent of a Y and X value, yielding the angle between the X-axis and a line from the origin to that point.

zh_cn.title: 弹奏音符 (vector, number, number →)
zh_cn.text:
移除栈顶的一个向量和两个数。在指定位置以指定 乐器 （由第一个数决定）弹奏 一个音 （由第二个数决定）。消耗极少量 媒质 。
共有 16 种 乐器 和 25 种 音高 。两者的下标均从 0 开始。
这些乐器似乎就是 音符盒 对应的各种乐器，尽管其具体对应关系不得而知。
不管怎么说，用 探知透镜 观察 音符盒 就能得知其乐器对应的数字。

en_us.title: Make Note (vector, number, number →)
en_us.text:
Remove a vector and two numbers from the stack. Plays an instrument defined by the first number at the given location, with a note defined by the second number. Costs a negligible amount of media .
There appear to be 16 different instruments and 25 different notes . Both are indexed by zero.
These seem to be the same instruments I can produce with a Note Block , though the reason for each instrument's number being what it is eludes me.
Either way, I can find the numbers I need to use by inspecting a Note Block through a Scrying Lens .

zh_cn.title: 闪现 (entity, number →)
zh_cn.text: 移除栈顶的实体和表示长度的数，然后将所给实体沿其视线方向向前传送所给长度格。 每传送两格消耗大约 1 个 紫水晶碎片 。

en_us.title: Blink (entity, number →)
en_us.text: Remove an entity and length from the stack, then teleport the given entity along its look vector by the given length. Costs about one Amethyst Shard per two blocks travelled.

zh_cn.title: 催生 (vector →)
zh_cn.text: 使目标位置的植物或树苗更快成长，就像对其施以 骨粉 一样。消耗略多于 1 个 紫水晶粉 。

en_us.title: Overgrow (vector →)
en_us.text: Encourage a plant or sapling at the target position to grow, as if Bonemeal was applied. Costs a bit more than one Amethyst Dust .

zh_cn.title: 占卜师之纯化 (any → bool)
zh_cn.text: 将参数变换为布尔值。数 0 、 Null ，以及空列表会变为 False。其余所有则变为 True。

en_us.title: Augur's Purification (any → bool)
en_us.text: Convert an argument to a boolean. The number 0 , Null , and the empty list become False; everything else becomes True.

zh_cn.title: 剥离意识 (entity, vector →)
zh_cn.text:
我搞不懂这个法术……说实话，我也不清楚我到底想不想搞懂。
Not an official Minecraft product. Not approved by or associated with Mojang or Microsoft. Minecraft content and materials are the intellectual property of their respective owners. Made with ❤️ using hexdoc .

en_us.title: Flay Mind (entity, vector →)
en_us.text:
I cannot make heads or tails of this spell... To be honest, I'm not sure I want to know what it does.
Not an official Minecraft product. Not approved by or associated with Mojang or Microsoft. Minecraft content and materials are the intellectual property of their respective owners. Made with ❤️ using hexdoc .

zh_cn.title: 破坏方块 (vector →)
zh_cn.text: 移除一个位置向量，然后破坏给定位置的方块。此法术能破坏几乎所有钻石镐能破坏的方块。 消耗大约 1/8 个 紫水晶粉 。

en_us.title: Break Block (vector →)
en_us.text: Remove a location from the stack, then break the block at the given location. This spell can break nearly anything a Diamond Pickaxe can break. Costs about an eighth of one Amethyst Dust .

zh_cn.title: 取顶之纯化 (num|vec → num|vec)
zh_cn.text: 对一个数取顶，也即将小数部分不为零的数换为大于其的最小整数。或对向量的每个分量取顶。

en_us.title: Ceiling Purification (num|vec → num|vec)
en_us.text: Ceilings a number, raising it to the next integer value if it has a fractional component. If passed a vector, instead ceils each of its components.

zh_cn.title: 主要折角之精思 (→ vector)
zh_cn.text: 返回该法术环影响范围的东南靠上转角的位置。

en_us.title: Greater Fold Reflection (→ vector)
en_us.text: Returns the position of the upper-south-east corner of the bounds of this spell circle.

zh_cn.title: 次要折角之精思 (→ vector)
zh_cn.text: 返回该法术环影响范围的西北靠下转角的位置。

en_us.title: Lesser Fold Reflection (→ vector)
en_us.text: Returns the position of the lower-north-west corner of the bounds of this spell circle.

names.ja_jp: ロードストーンの反射

zh_cn.title: 磁石之精思 (→ vector)
zh_cn.text: 以单位向量返回该法术环的 促动石 的面朝方向。

en_us.title: Lodestone Reflection (→ vector)
en_us.text: Returns the direction the Impetus of this spell circle is facing as a unit vector.

names.ja_jp: ウェイストーンの反射

zh_cn.title: 指路石之精思 (→ vector)
zh_cn.text: 返回该法术环的 促动石 的位置。

en_us.title: Waystone Reflection (→ vector)
en_us.text: Returns the position of the Impetus of this spell circle.

zh_cn.text:
如果绘制内省后再绘制一个 内省 ，则它也将被加到列表中，而且需绘制 两次 反思 才能回到正常施法模式。
而且，如果在绘制 内省 和 反思 前绘制一个 考察 ，就能绕过它们的特殊功能，并将它们作为普通图案加到栈中，且不会影响返回正常施法模式前要绘制的 反思 个数。
如果在 考察中 连续绘制两个 考察 ，只有第一个 考察 会被加到栈中。

en_us.text:
If I draw another Introspection , it'll still be saved to the list, but I'll then have to draw two Retrospections to get back to normal casting.
Also, I can escape the special behavior of Intro- and Retrospection by drawing a Consideration before them, which will simply add them to the list without affecting which the number of Retrospections I need to return to casting.
If I draw two Considerations in a row while introspecting , it will add a single Consideration to the list.

zh_cn.title: 轴向之纯化 (vec|num → vec|num)
zh_cn.text: 若栈顶为向量，则返回与其夹角最小的轴向单位向量；零向量不受影响。若栈顶为数，则返回该数的符号；所给数为正则返回 1，为负责返回 -1，0 不受影响。

en_us.title: Axial Purification (vec|num → vec|num)
en_us.text: For a vector, coerce it to its nearest axial direction, a unit vector. For a number, return the sign of the number; 1 if positive, -1 if negative. In both cases, zero is unaffected.

zh_cn.title: 内化染色剂
zh_cn.text: 我需要在施法时在另一只手中持有 染色剂 。施法后，染色剂将被消耗而我意识的颜色也将永久改变（至少是在再次施法前）。消耗大约 1 个 紫水晶粉 。

en_us.title: Internalize Pigment
en_us.text: I must be holding a Pigment in my other hand to cast this spell. When I do, it will consume the dye and permanently change my mind's coloration (at least, until I cast the spell again). Costs about one Amethyst Dust .

zh_cn.title: 构筑方块 (vector →)
zh_cn.text: 在给定位置构筑一个空灵缥缈却坚硬可触的，闪着光的方块。消耗大约 1 个 紫水晶粉 。

en_us.title: Conjure Block (vector →)
en_us.text: Conjure an ethereal, but solid, block that sparkles with my pigment at the given position. Costs about one Amethyst Dust .

zh_cn.title: 构筑光源 (vector →)
zh_cn.text: 在给定位置构筑一个发着我染色剂颜色的光的魔法光源。消耗大约 1 个 紫水晶粉 。

en_us.title: Conjure Light (vector →)
en_us.text: Conjure a magical light that softly glows with my pigment at the given position. Costs about one Amethyst Dust .

zh_cn.title: 欧拉之精思 (→ num)
zh_cn.text: 返回 e ，也即自然对数的底。

en_us.title: Euler's Reflection (→ num)
en_us.text: Adds e , the base of natural logarithms, to the stack.

zh_cn.title: 弧之精思 (→ num)
zh_cn.text: 返回 π，也即半圆的弧度。

en_us.title: Arc's Reflection (→ num)
en_us.text: Adds π, the radial representation of half a circle, to the stack.

zh_cn.title: 圆之精思 (→ num)
zh_cn.text: 返回 τ，也即圆的弧度。

en_us.title: Circle's Reflection (→ num)
en_us.text: Adds τ, the radial representation of a complete circle, to the stack.

zh_cn.title: 假之精思 (→ bool)
zh_cn.text: 返回 False 。

en_us.title: False Reflection (→ bool)
en_us.text: Adds False to the top of the stack.

zh_cn.title: 空元之精思 (→ null)
zh_cn.text: 返回 Null 这一虚指。

en_us.title: Nullary Reflection (→ null)
en_us.text: Adds the Null influence to the top of the stack.

zh_cn.title: 真之精思 (→ bool)
zh_cn.text: 返回 True 。

en_us.title: True Reflection (→ bool)
en_us.text: Adds True to the top of the stack.

en_us.title: Vector Reflection Zero (→ vector)
en_us.text: Adds [0, 0, 0] to the stack.

zh_cn.title: 演讲者之馏化 (list, any → list)
zh_cn.text: 移除栈顶元素，将其加到栈顶列表的开头。

en_us.title: Speaker's Distillation (list, any → list)
en_us.text: Remove the top iota, then add it as the first element to the list at the top of the stack.

zh_cn.title: 向量之提整 (num, num, num → vector)
zh_cn.text: 将三个数作为向量的 X，Y，Z 分量组合（最下方为 X 分量）。

en_us.title: Vector Exaltation (num, num, num → vector)
en_us.text: Combine three numbers at the top of the stack into a vector's X, Y, and Z components (top to bottom).

zh_cn.title: 余弦之纯化 (num → num)
zh_cn.text: 计算所给角（弧度制）的余弦，也即该角在单位圆上的横坐标。与 π 和 τ 的值有关。

en_us.title: Cosine Purification (num → num)
en_us.text: Takes the cosine of an angle in radians, yielding the horizontal component of that angle drawn on a unit circle. Related to the values of π and τ .

names.ja_jp: アーティファクト作成

zh_cn.title: 制作造物 (entity, [pattern] →)
zh_cn.text: 消耗大约 10 个 充能紫水晶 。

en_us.title: Craft Artifact (entity, [pattern] →)
en_us.text: Costs about ten Charged Amethysts .

zh_cn.title: 制作试剂瓶 (entity →)
zh_cn.text:
将 媒质 注入一个玻璃瓶，从而制成 试剂瓶 。
和用于 制作施法物品 的法术类似，我需要在另一只手中拿着一个 玻璃瓶 ，并提供一个 紫水晶 物品实体作为参数。更多信息参见 此页 。
消耗大约 1 个 充能紫水晶 。

en_us.title: Craft Phial (entity →)
en_us.text:
Infuse a bottle with media to form a Phial.
Similarly to the spells for Crafting Casting Items , I must hold a Glass Bottle in my other hand, and provide the spell with a dropped stack of Amethyst . See this page for more information.
Costs about one Charged Amethyst .

zh_cn.title: 制作杂件 (entity, [pattern] →)
zh_cn.text: 消耗大约 1 个 充能紫水晶 。

en_us.title: Craft Cypher (entity, [pattern] →)
en_us.text: Costs about one Charged Amethyst .

zh_cn.title: 制作缀品 (entity, [pattern] →)
zh_cn.text: 消耗大约 5 个 充能紫水晶 。

en_us.title: Craft Trinket (entity, [pattern] →)
en_us.text: Costs about five Charged Amethysts .

zh_cn.title: 制造熔岩 (vector →)
zh_cn.text:
在给定位置生成一格熔岩（或给流体容器注入至多一桶熔岩）。消耗大约 1 个 充能紫水晶 。
建议不要声张自己知道这个法术。某些植物学家对此……比较敏感，至少我听说是这样。
也罢，确实没人说过探究宇宙最深层的秘密是什么好干的活。

en_us.title: Create Lava (vector →)
en_us.text:
Summon a block of lava (or insert up to a bucket's worth) into a block at the given position. Costs about one Charged Amethyst .
It may be advisable to keep my knowledge of this spell secret. A certain faction of botanists get... touchy about it, or so I've heard.
Well, no one said tracing the deep secrets of the universe was going to be an easy time.

zh_cn.title: 制造水源 (vector →)
zh_cn.text: 在给定位置生成一格水（或给流体容器注入至多一桶水）。消耗大约 1 个 紫水晶粉 。

en_us.title: Create Water (vector →)
en_us.text: Summon a block of water (or insert up to a bucket's worth) into a block at the given position. Costs about one Amethyst Dust .

zh_cn.title: 演讲者之分解 (list → list, any)
zh_cn.text: 移除栈顶列表中的第一个元素，并将该元素压入栈顶。

en_us.title: Speaker's Decomposition (list → list, any)
en_us.text: Remove the first iota from the list at the top of the stack, then push that iota to the stack.

zh_cn.title: 向量之拆解 (vector → num, num, num)
zh_cn.text: 将一个向量拆分为其 X，Y，Z 分量（最下方为 X 分量）。

en_us.title: Vector Disintegration (vector → num, num, num)
en_us.text: Split a vector into its X, Y, and Z components (top to bottom).

zh_cn.title: 清除流体 (vector →)
zh_cn.text: 清空给定位置的流体容器，或是清除给定位置周围的液体。消耗大约 2 个 充能紫水晶 。

en_us.title: Destroy Liquid (vector →)
en_us.text: Drains either a liquid container at, or a body of liquid around, the given position. Costs about two Charged Amethyst .

zh_cn.title: 驱雨
zh_cn.text: 召雨的反面。此法术会将我所处世界的雨水驱离。消耗大约 1 个 紫水晶碎片 。若未在下雨就无效。

en_us.title: Dispel Rain
en_us.text: A counterpart to summoning rain. This spell will dispel rain across the world I cast it upon. Costs about one Amethyst Shard . Does nothing if the skies are already clear.

zh_cn.title: 除法之馏化 (num|vec, num|vec → num|vec)
zh_cn.text:
执行除法或叉积。
操作如下：
若栈顶为两个数，返回其商。
若为一个数和一个向量，移除该数并将向量的每个分量与其相除。
若为两个向量，计算其 叉积 。
第一第二种情况下，栈顶元素或其分量为除数，栈顶往下第二元素或其分量为被除数。
警告：绝对不可除以零！

en_us.title: Division Dstl. (num|vec, num|vec → num|vec)
en_us.text:
Perform division or the cross product.
As such:
With two numbers, combines them into their quotient.
With a number and a vector, removes the number and divides it by each element of the vector.
With two vectors, combines them into their cross product .
In the first and second cases, the top of the stack or its components comprise the dividend, and the second-from-the-top or its components are the divisor.
WARNING: Never divide by zero!

zh_cn.title: 双子之分解 (any → any, any)
zh_cn.text: 复制栈顶的 iota。

en_us.title: Gemini Decomposition (any → any, any)
en_us.text: Duplicates the top iota of the stack.

zh_cn.title: 双子之策略 (any, number → many)
zh_cn.text: 移除栈顶的数，然后将现在的栈顶元素复制该数次。（若所给数为 2，则栈顶会有两个同一元素。）

en_us.title: Gemini Gambit (any, number → many)
en_us.text: Removes the number at the top of the stack, then copies the top iota of the stack that number of times. (A count of 2 results in two of the iota on the stack, not three.)

zh_cn.title: 启迪树苗 (vector →)
zh_cn.text: 将 媒质 强制注入目标位置的树苗，使其长为 启迪树 。消耗大约 1 个 充能紫水晶 。

en_us.title: Edify Sapling (vector →)
en_us.text: Forcibly infuse media into the sapling at the target position, causing it to grow into an Edified Tree . Costs about one Charged Amethyst .

zh_cn.title: 空无之精思 (→ list)
zh_cn.text: 压入一个空列表。

en_us.title: Vacant Reflection (→ list)
en_us.text: Push an empty list to the top of the stack.

zh_cn.title: 指南针之纯化 (entity → vector)
zh_cn.text: 将栈顶的实体变为其眼部位置。这个图案比较适用于我自己。

en_us.title: Compass' Purification (entity → vector)
en_us.text: Transforms an entity on the stack into the position of its eyes. I should probably use this on myself.

zh_cn.title: 指南针之纯化，第二型 (entity → vector)
zh_cn.text: 将栈顶的实体变为其所站位置。这个图案比较适用于其他实体。

en_us.title: Compass' Purification II (entity → vector)
en_us.text: Transforms an entity on the stack into the position it is standing. I should probably use this on other entities.

zh_cn.title: 相等之馏化 (any, any → bool)
zh_cn.text: 如果第一个参数等于第二个（允许较小误差），返回 True。否则返回 False。

en_us.title: Equality Distillation (any, any → bool)
en_us.text: If the first argument equals the second (within a small tolerance), return True. Otherwise, return False.

zh_cn.title: 清除物品
zh_cn.text:
清除另一只手中写有 咒术 的物品。消耗大约 1 个 紫水晶粉 。
此法术也会清除物品内存储的 媒质 ，将其释放给自然并将物品恢复到其初始状态。如此就能回收利用容易出错的 缀品 了。
此法术也能清除 核心 和 法术书 书页内容，同时去除其上密封。

en_us.title: Erase Item
en_us.text:
Clear a Hex -containing item in my other hand. Costs about one Amethyst Dust .
The spell will also void all the media stored inside the item, releasing it back to Nature and returning the item to a perfectly clean slate. This way, I can re-use Trinkets I have put an erroneous spell into, for example.
This also works to clear a Focus or Spellbook page, unsealing them in the process.

zh_cn.text:
要使用 考察 ，先绘制它，然后绘制任意图案。第二个图案就会被加到栈中。
如果对计算机科学有足够了解的话，你可能能将其与“转义”/“escape”操作联系起来。
考察的一大用途是将某一图案复制到 卷轴 或 石板 上，且要和 书吏之策略 配合使用。这之后卷轴和石板就能拿来装饰了。

en_us.text:
To use Consideration , I draw it, then another arbitrary pattern. That second pattern is added to the stack.
One may find it helpful to think of this as escaping the pattern onto the stack, if they happen to be familiar with the science of computers.
The usual use for this is to copy the pattern to a Scroll or Slate using Scribe's Gambit , and then perhaps decorating with them.

zh_cn.title: 赫尔墨斯之策略 ([pattern] | pattern → many)
zh_cn.text:
移除栈顶的图案列表，然后就像我用 法杖 施法一样依次运行（直到碰到 卡戎之策略 ）。如果一个 iota 已用 考察 或 类似手段 作为图案加入栈中，那么该 iota 将在运行时被加到栈中。否则其将在非图案元素运行失败。
若与 核心 同时使用，它将提供 极为 强大的操控能力。
据我找到的一张奇特卷轴所称，它还将自然的咒法体系变为了一个“图灵完备”的系统。
然而， 咒术 能重复执行自身的次数是有限的——自然不会对失控的法术手软的！
此外，若让图案不在我的引导下操控能量，那么任何事故都可能导致后续操作不稳定甚至直接执行不了。

en_us.title: Hermes' Gambit ([pattern] | pattern → many)
en_us.text:
Remove a pattern or list of patterns from the stack, then cast them as if I had drawn them myself with my Staff (until a Charon's Gambit is encountered). If an iota is escaped with Consideration or its ilk , it will be pushed to the stack. Otherwise, non-patterns will fail.
This can be very powerful in tandem with Foci .
It also makes the bureaucracy of Nature a Turing-complete system, according to one esoteric scroll I found.
However, it seems there's a limit to how many times a Hex can cast itself-- Nature doesn't look kindly on runaway spells!
In addition, with the energies of the patterns occurring without me to guide them, any mishap will cause the remaining actions to become too unstable and immediately unravel.

zh_cn.title: 伊里斯之策略 ([pattern] | pattern → many)
zh_cn.text:
此图案和 赫尔墨斯之策略 类似，也能运行图案或依次运行图案列表，但会在开始之前将一独特的“跳转” iota 压入栈中。
当执行至“跳转” iota 时，法术会直接跳过图案列表中剩余的图案至列表尾部。
当然因为已经有了 卡戎之策略 ，这种性质难免显得有些冗余。不过它能以可控方式退出 多层嵌套 调用的 赫尔墨斯之策略 ，而卡戎之策略只能退出一层。
“跳转” iota 甚至会在所有策略都执行完毕后还留在栈上……真是细思恐极。

en_us.title: Iris' Gambit ([pattern] | pattern → many)
en_us.text:
Cast a pattern or list of patterns from the stack exactly like Hermes' Gambit , except that a unique Jump iota is pushed to the stack beforehand.
When the Jump -iota is executed, it'll skip the rest of the patterns and jump directly to the end of the pattern list.
While this may seem redundant given Charon's Gambit exists, this allows you to exit nested Hermes' invocations in a controlled way, where Charon only allows you to exit one.
The Jump iota will apparently stay on the stack even after execution is finished... better not think about the implications of that.

zh_cn.title: 爆炸 (vector, number →)
zh_cn.text:
移除栈顶的数和向量，并在所给位置产生一次强度为所给数的爆炸。
强度为 3 的爆炸与苦力怕的爆炸相当，4 则与 TNT 的相当。自然倒是不让我产生强度大于 10 的爆炸。
奇怪的是，这种爆炸伤不到我。也许是因为这爆炸是 我 引起的？
强度为 0 时消耗极少量媒质，每加一级强度多消耗 3 个 紫水晶粉 。

en_us.title: Explosion (vector, number →)
en_us.text:
Remove a number and vector from the stack, then create an explosion at the given location with the given power.
A power of 3 is about as much as a Creeper's blast; 4 is about as much as a TNT blast. Nature refuses to give me a blast of more than 10 power, though.
Strangely, this explosion doesn't seem to harm me. Perhaps it's because I am the one exploding?
Costs a negligible amount at power 0, plus 3 extra Amethyst Dust per point of explosion power.

zh_cn.title: 火球 (vector, number →)
zh_cn.text:
移除栈顶的数和向量，并在所给位置产生一次强度为所给数的带火焰的爆炸。
消耗 1 个 紫水晶粉 ，每加一级强度多消耗 3 个 紫水晶粉 。就和 爆炸 一模一样，除了带点火。

en_us.title: Fireball (vector, number →)
en_us.text:
Remove a number and vector from the stack, then create a fiery explosion at the given location with the given power.
Costs one Amethyst Dust , plus about 3 extra Amethyst Dust s per point of explosion power. Otherwise, the same as Explosion , except with fire.

zh_cn.title: 广域熄灭 (vector →)
zh_cn.text: 熄灭周围较大区域内的火焰。消耗大约 6 个 紫水晶粉 。

en_us.title: Extinguish Area (vector →)
en_us.text: Extinguish blocks in a large area. Costs about six Amethyst Dust .

zh_cn.title: 渔夫之策略 (number → any)
zh_cn.text: 提出下标为所给数的元素并将其置于栈顶。

en_us.title: Fisherman's Gambit (number → any)
en_us.text: Grabs the element in the stack indexed by the number and brings it to the top. If the number is negative, instead moves the top element of the stack down that many elements.

zh_cn.title: 渔夫之策略，第二型 (number → any)
zh_cn.text: 与 渔夫之策略 类似，但会复制 iota 而非将其提出。

en_us.title: Fisherman's Gambit II (number → any)
en_us.text: Like Fisherman's Gambit , but instead of moving the iota, copies it.

zh_cn.title: 翱翔 (player →)
zh_cn.text:
此法术会将一束 媒质 在我身旁塑成翅膀状，并赋予其足够物质性，从而允许施法者滑翔。
这对翅膀的操作方式与 鞘翅 完全一致。目标（必须是玩家）会被弹起而升空，此时按下空格就能张开翅膀。这些翅膀十分脆弱，会在触碰到任意表面时破碎消失。长距飞行则可能需要 驱动 或者 烟花火箭 （可能稍显鲁莽）的协助。
消耗大约 1 个 充能紫水晶 。

en_us.title: Altiora (player →)
en_us.text:
Summon a sheaf of media about me in the shape of wings, endowed with enough substance to allow gliding.
Using them is identical to using Elytra ; the target (which must be a player) is lofted into the air, after which pressing Jump will deploy the wings. The wings are fragile, and break upon touching any surface. Longer flights may benefit from Impulse or (for the foolhardy) Fireworks .
Costs about one Charged Crystal .

zh_cn.title: 隐士之飞行 (entity, number →)
zh_cn.text:
受范围限制的飞行法术。
第二参数代表水平方向上的半径（以米计），在此范围内，法术能保持稳定。走出该范围就会结束该法术，滞空的物体会直接坠向地面。但只要一直呆在这个范围内，法术的效果便会无限持续。此法术还会额外产生微量 媒质 用以标记安全区域中心点。
每米安全范围消耗大约 1 个 紫水晶粉 。

en_us.title: Anchorite's Flight (entity, number →)
en_us.text:
A flight limited in its range.
The second argument is a horizontal radius, in meters, in which the spell is stable. Moving outside of that radius will end the spell, dropping me out of the sky. As long as I stay inside the safe zone, however, the spell lasts indefinitely. An additional shimmer of media marks the origin point of the safe zone.
Costs about 1 Amethyst Dust per meter of safety.

zh_cn.title: 旅者之飞行 (entity, number →)
zh_cn.text:
受时间限制的飞行法术。
第二参数代表持续时间（以秒计），在此限制内，法术能保持稳定。持续时间超过限制就会结束该法术，滞空的物体会直接坠向地面。
此法术相对较昂贵，每秒持续时间消耗大约 1 个 充能紫水晶 。我觉得它极其适合长途旅行。
这类法术据信极难施放，但也极为强力。记载它们的文献极为少见（据称理由充分）。这也许只是某些消亡的老古董口中的胡言乱语，不过——它们只是简单的图案罢了。
试试看又能出什么错呢？

en_us.title: Wayfarer's Flight (entity, number →)
en_us.text:
A flight limited in its duration.
The second argument is an amount of time in seconds for which the spell is stable. After that time, the spell ends and I am dropped from the sky.
It is relatively expensive at about 1 Charged Crystal per second of flight; I believe it is best suited for travel.
The spells catalogued here are purported to be of legendary difficulty and power. They seem to have been recorded only sparsely (for good reason, the texts claim). It's probably just the ramblings of extinct traditionalists, though -- a pattern's a pattern.
What could possibly go wrong?

zh_cn.title: 取底之纯化 (num|vec → num|vec)
zh_cn.text: 对一个数取底，也即去掉小数部分取整。或对向量的每个分量取底。

en_us.title: Floor Purification (num|vec → num|vec)
en_us.text: Floors a number, cutting off the fractional component and leaving an integer value. If passed a vector, instead floors each of its components.

zh_cn.title: 托特之策略 (list of patterns, list → list)
zh_cn.text:
移除栈中的一个图案列表和一个列表，然后对后一列表中的每个元素运行前一图案列表中的图案。
更确切地说，对应后一列表中的每个元素，它将：
创建一个新栈，其中包括当前栈中的所有元素和后一列表中的一个元素。
绘制前一列表中的所有图案。
将该栈中剩余的所有元素存进一个列表。 在所有元素都运行一遍后，将该列表压入原本的栈中。
也难怪精通此操作的人都疯了。

en_us.title: Thoth's Gambit (list of patterns, list → list)
en_us.text:
Remove a list of patterns and a list from the stack, then cast the given pattern over each element of the second list.
More specifically, for each element in the second list, it will:
Create a new stack, with everything on the current stack plus that element
Draw all the patterns in the first list
Save all the iotas remaining on the stack to a list Then, after all is said and done, pushes the list of saved iotas onto the main stack.
No wonder all the practitioners of this art go mad.

zh_cn.title: 意识之精思 (→ entity | null)
zh_cn.text: 返回我，也就是施法者。

en_us.title: Mind's Reflection (→ entity | null)
en_us.text: Adds me, the caster, to the stack.

zh_cn.title: 实体之纯化 (vector → entity or null)
zh_cn.text: 将栈顶位置向量变为该处实体（若无则返回 Null ）。

en_us.title: Entity Purification (vector → entity or null)
en_us.text: Transform the position on the stack into the entity at that location (or Null if there isn't one).

zh_cn.title: 测高仪之纯化 (entity → num)
zh_cn.text: 将栈顶的实体变为其高度。

en_us.title: Stadiometer's Prfn. (entity → num)
en_us.text: Transforms an entity on the stack into its height.

zh_cn.title: 照准仪之纯化 (entity → vector)
zh_cn.text: 将栈顶的实体变为其视线方向上的单位向量。

en_us.title: Alidade's Purification (entity → vector)
en_us.text: Transforms an entity on the stack into the direction it's looking in, as a unit vector.

zh_cn.title: 步伐之纯化 (entity → vector)
zh_cn.text: 将栈顶的实体变为其移动方向上的向量，其模长为实体的移动速度。

en_us.title: Pace Purification (entity → vector)
en_us.text: Transforms an entity on the stack into the direction in which it's moving, with the speed of that movement as that direction's magnitude.

zh_cn.title: 实体之纯化：动物 (vector → entity or null)
zh_cn.text: 将栈顶位置向量变为该处动物（若无则返回 Null ）。

en_us.title: Entity Prfn.: Animal (vector → entity or null)
en_us.text: Transform the position on the stack into the animal at that location (or Null if there isn't one).

names.ja_jp: 実体の浄化: アイテム

zh_cn.title: 实体之纯化：物品 (vector → entity or null)
zh_cn.text: 将栈顶位置向量变为该处物品实体（若无则返回 Null ）。

en_us.title: Entity Prfn.: Item (vector → entity or null)
en_us.text: Transform the position on the stack into the dropped item at that location (or Null if there isn't one).

zh_cn.title: 实体之纯化：生物 (vector → entity or null)
zh_cn.text: 将栈顶位置向量变为该处生物（若无则返回 Null ）。

en_us.title: Entity Prfn.: Living (vector → entity or null)
en_us.text: Transform the position on the stack into the living creature at that location (or Null if there isn't one).

names.ja_jp: 実体の浄化: モンスター

zh_cn.title: 实体之纯化：怪物 (vector → entity or null)
zh_cn.text: 将栈顶位置向量变为该处怪物（若无则返回 Null ）。

en_us.title: Entity Prfn.: Monster (vector → entity or null)
en_us.text: Transform the position on the stack into the monster at that location (or Null if there isn't one).

names.ja_jp: 実体の浄化: プレイヤー

zh_cn.title: 实体之纯化：玩家 (vector → entity or null)
zh_cn.text: 将栈顶位置向量变为该处玩家（若无则返回 Null ）。

en_us.title: Entity Prfn.: Player (vector → entity or null)
en_us.text: Transform the position on the stack into the player at that location (or Null if there isn't one).

zh_cn.title: 至大之馏化 (number, number → bool)
zh_cn.text: 如果第一个参数大于第二个，返回 True. 否则返回 False。

en_us.title: Maximus Distillation (number, number → bool)
en_us.text: If the first argument is greater than the second, return True. Otherwise, return False.

zh_cn.title: 至大之馏化，第二型 (number, number → bool)
zh_cn.text: 如果第一个参数大于或等于第二个，返回 True。否则返回 False。

en_us.title: Maximus Distillation II (number, number → bool)
en_us.text: If the first argument is greater than or equal to the second, return True. Otherwise, return False.

zh_cn.title: 卡戎之策略
zh_cn.text:
这个图案将强制停止 咒术 的施放。它独自出现可能没什么用，我只要不绘制图案或是放下法杖就行了。
但当与 赫尔墨斯之策略 或 托特之策略 一起使用时，它就将发挥 大 用。那些图案会碰到这个休止符，但 咒术 本身不会停止，停止运行的是那些策略。它可以用来防止 托特之策略 将每个 iota 都运行一遍。这便是逃离疯狂的秘道。

en_us.title: Charon's Gambit
en_us.text:
This pattern forcibly halts a Hex . This is mostly useless on its own, as I could simply just stop writing patterns, or put down my staff.
But when combined with Hermes' or Thoth's Gambits , it becomes far more interesting. Those patterns serve to 'contain' that halting, and rather than ending the entire Hex , those gambits end instead. This can be used to cause Thoth's Gambit not to operate on every iota it's given. An escape from the madness, as it were.

zh_cn.title: 占卜师之提整 (bool, any, any → any)
zh_cn.text: 如果第一个参数是 True，保留第二个参数并移除第三个。否则保留第三个参数并移除第二个。

en_us.title: Augur's Exaltation (bool, any, any → any)
en_us.text: If the first argument is True, keeps the second and discards the third; otherwise discards the second and keeps the third.

zh_cn.title: 点燃方块 (vector →)
zh_cn.text: 在给定位置上方生火，就像在该位置使用 火焰弹 一样。消耗大约 1 个 紫水晶粉 。

en_us.title: Ignite Block (vector →)
en_us.text: Start a fire on top of the given location, as if a Fire Charge was applied. Costs about one Amethyst Dust .

zh_cn.title: 选择之馏化 (list, number → any)
zh_cn.text: 移除栈顶的数，将栈顶的列表变为其中下标为该数（就是被移除的那个数）的元素。若该数越界，则将列表换为 Null 。

en_us.title: Selection Distillation (list, number → any)
en_us.text: Remove the number at the top of the stack, then replace the list at the top with the nth element of that list (where n is the number you removed). Replaces the list with Null if the number is out of bounds.

zh_cn.title: 定位器之馏化 (list, any → num)
zh_cn.text: 移除栈顶元素，并将栈顶列表变为该元素在其中第一次出现的位置（从 0 开始）。若没有出现过则返回 -1。

en_us.title: Locator's Distillation (list, any → num)
en_us.text: Remove the iota at the top of the stack, then replace the list at the top with the first index of that iota within the list (starting from 0). Replaces the list with -1 if the iota doesn't exist in the list.

zh_cn.title: 群体之策略 (many, num → list)
zh_cn.text: 移除 所给数 个元素，并将这些元素加入列表并将该列表压入栈顶。

en_us.title: Flock's Gambit (many, num → list)
en_us.text: Remove num elements from the stack, then add them to a list at the top of the stack.

zh_cn.title: 至小之馏化 (number, number → bool)
zh_cn.text: 如果第一个参数小于第二个，返回 True。否则返回 False。

en_us.title: Minimus Distillation (number, number → bool)
en_us.text: If the first argument is less than the second, return True. Otherwise, return False.

zh_cn.title: 至小之馏化，第二型 (number, number → bool)
zh_cn.text: 如果第一个参数小于或等于第二个，返回 True。否则返回 False。

en_us.title: Minimus Distillation II (number, number → bool)
en_us.text: If the first argument is less than or equal to the second, return True. Otherwise, return False.

zh_cn.title: 召雷 (vector →)
zh_cn.text: 我能命令苍穹！此法术会在我所想之处召唤一道落雷。消耗大约 3 个 紫水晶碎片 。

en_us.title: Summon Lightning (vector →)
en_us.text: I command the heavens! This spell will summon a bolt of lightning to strike the earth where I direct it. Costs about three Amethyst Shards .

zh_cn.title: 对数之馏化 (num, num → num)
zh_cn.text: 计算以栈顶元素为底的，栈顶往下第二元素为真数的对数。与 e 的值有关。

en_us.title: Logarithmic Distillation (num, num → num)
en_us.text: Removes the number at the top of the stack, then takes the logarithm of the number at the top using the other number as its base. Related to the value of e .

zh_cn.title: 余数之馏化 (num|vec, num|vec → num|vec)
zh_cn.text: 取两数除法的余数。也即执行除法后 剩余 的数。例如，5 % 2 得 1，5 % 3 得 2。或对向量的每个分量执行上述操作。

en_us.title: Modulus Distillation (num|vec, num|vec → num|vec)
en_us.text: Takes the modulus of two numbers. This is the amount remaining after division - for example, 5 % 2 is 1, and 5 % 3 is 2. When applied on vectors, performs the above operation elementwise.

zh_cn.title: 乘法之馏化 (num|vec, num|vec → num|vec)
zh_cn.text:
执行乘法或点积。
操作如下：
若栈顶为两个数，返回其积。
若为一个数和一个向量，移除该数并将向量的每个分量与其相乘。
若为两个向量，计算其 点积 。

en_us.title: Multiplicative Dstl. (num|vec, num|vec → num|vec)
en_us.text:
Perform multiplication or the dot product.
As such:
With two numbers, combines them into their product.
With a number and a vector, removes the number from the stack and multiplies each component of the vector by that number.
With two vectors, combines them into their dot product .

zh_cn.title: 取非之纯化 (num → num)
zh_cn.text: 对位组执行位非操作，将所有为 1 的比特换为 0，反之亦然。就我经验而言，这会使一个数变为其相反数，然后减 1。例如，0 会变成 -1，而 -100 会变成 99。

en_us.title: Negation Purification (num → num)
en_us.text: Takes the inversion of a bitset, changing all on bits to off and vice versa. In my experience, this will take the form of that number negated and decreased by one. For example, 0 will become -1, and -100 will become 99.

zh_cn.title: 不等之馏化 (any, any → bool)
zh_cn.text: 如果第一个参数不等于第二个（允许较小误差），返回 True。否则返回 False。

en_us.title: Inequality Distillation (any, any → bool)
en_us.text: If the first argument does not equal the second (outside a small tolerance), return True. Otherwise, return False.

zh_cn.text: 绘制 内省 会让这之后绘制的图案不再与操作联系。而在绘制 反思 后，之前绘制的图案就会作为一个列表加到栈中。

en_us.text: Drawing Introspection makes my drawing of patterns act differently, for a time. Until I draw Retrospection , the patterns I draw are saved. Then, when I draw Retrospection , they are added to the stack as a list iota.

zh_cn.title: 析取之馏化 ((num, num)|(list, list) → num|list)
zh_cn.text:
取两集合的并集。
操作如下：
若栈顶为两个数，将其组合为在两个位组中有一个为 1 处为 1 的位组。
若栈顶为两个列表，则创建一个由第一个列表中所有元素和第二个列表独有的元素组成的列表。和 组合之馏化 类似。

en_us.title: Disjunction Distillation ((num, num)|(list, list) → num|list)
en_us.text:
Unifies two sets.
As such:
With two numbers at the top of the stack, combines them into a bitset containing every on bit in either bitset.
With two lists, this creates a list of every element from the first list, plus every element from the second list that is not in the first list. This is similar to Combination Distillation .

zh_cn.title: 勘探者之策略 (any, any → any, any, any)
zh_cn.text: 将栈顶往下第二元素复制至栈顶。[0, 1] 变为 [0, 1, 0]。

en_us.title: Prospector's Gambit (any, any → any, any, any)
en_us.text: Copy the second-to-last iota of the stack to the top. [0, 1] becomes [0, 1, 0].

zh_cn.title: 放置方块 (vector →)
zh_cn.text: 移除一个位置向量，然后挑选一个方块并放在给定位置。 消耗大约 1/8 个 紫水晶粉 。

en_us.title: Place Block (vector →)
en_us.text: Remove a location from the stack, then pick a block item and place it at the given location. Costs about an eighth of one Amethyst Dust .

zh_cn.title: 黑阳当空 (entity, number, number →)
zh_cn.text: 给予 伤害吸收 。每 1 秒持续时间的基础消耗为 1 个 紫水晶粉 。

en_us.title: Black Sun's Zenith (entity, number, number →)
en_us.text: Bestows absorption . Base cost is one Amethyst Dust per second.

zh_cn.title: 红阳当空 (entity, number, number →)
zh_cn.text: 给予 急迫 。每 3 秒持续时间的基础消耗为 1 个 紫水晶粉 。

en_us.title: Red Sun's Zenith (entity, number, number →)
en_us.text: Bestows haste . Base cost is one Amethyst Dust per 3 seconds.

zh_cn.title: 蓝阳西沉 (entity, number →)
zh_cn.text: 给予 飘浮 。每 5 秒持续时间的基础消耗为 1 个 紫水晶粉 。

en_us.title: Blue Sun's Nadir (entity, number →)
en_us.text: Inflicts levitation . Base cost is one Amethyst Dust per 5 seconds.

zh_cn.title: 蓝阳当空 (entity, number →)
zh_cn.text: 给予 夜视 。每 5 秒持续时间的基础消耗为 1 个 紫水晶粉 。

en_us.title: Blue Sun's Zenith (entity, number →)
en_us.text: Bestows night vision . Base cost is one Amethyst Dust per 5 seconds.

zh_cn.title: 红阳西沉 (entity, number, number →)
zh_cn.text: 给予 中毒 。每 3 秒持续时间的基础消耗为 1 个 紫水晶粉 。

en_us.title: Red Sun's Nadir (entity, number, number →)
en_us.text: Inflicts poison . Base cost is one Amethyst Dust per 3 seconds.

zh_cn.title: 白阳当空 (entity, number, number →)
zh_cn.text: 给予 生命恢复 。每 1 秒持续时间的基础消耗为 1 个 紫水晶粉 。

en_us.title: White Sun's Zenith (entity, number, number →)
en_us.text: Bestows regeneration . Base cost is one Amethyst Dust per second.

zh_cn.title: 绿阳西沉 (entity, number, number →)
zh_cn.text: 给予 缓慢 。每 5 秒持续时间的基础消耗为 1 个 紫水晶粉 。

en_us.title: Green Sun's Nadir (entity, number, number →)
en_us.text: Inflicts slowness . Base cost is one Amethyst Dust per 5 seconds.

zh_cn.title: 绿阳当空 (entity, number, number →)
zh_cn.text: 给予 力量 。每 3 秒持续时间的基础消耗为 1 个 紫水晶粉 。

en_us.title: Green Sun's Zenith (entity, number, number →)
en_us.text: Bestows strength . Base cost is one Amethyst Dust per 3 seconds.

zh_cn.title: 白阳西沉 (entity, number, number →)
zh_cn.text: 给予 虚弱 。每 10 秒持续时间的基础消耗为 1 个 紫水晶粉 。

en_us.title: White Sun's Nadir (entity, number, number →)
en_us.text: Inflicts weakness . Base cost is one Amethyst Dust per 10 seconds.

zh_cn.title: 黑阳西沉 (entity, number, number →)
zh_cn.text: 给予 凋零 。每 1 秒持续时间的基础消耗为 1 个 紫水晶粉 。

en_us.title: Black Sun's Nadir (entity, number, number →)
en_us.text: Inflicts withering . Base cost is one Amethyst Dust per second.

zh_cn.title: 乘方之馏化 (num|vec, num|vec → num|vec)
zh_cn.text:
执行乘方或向量射影。
若栈顶为两个数，返回两数的乘方。
若为一个数和一个向量，移除该数并计算向量的每个分量与该数的乘方。
若为两个向量，计算栈顶向量对栈顶往下第二向量的 向量射影 。
第一第二种情况下，栈顶元素或其分量为指数, 栈顶往下第二元素或其分量为底数。

en_us.title: Power Distillation (num|vec, num|vec → num|vec)
en_us.text:
Perform exponentiation or vector projection.
With two numbers, combines them by raising the first to the power of the second.
With a number and a vector, removes the number and raises each component of the vector to the number's power.
With two vectors, combines them into the vector projection of the top of the stack onto the second-from-the-top.
In the first and second cases, the first argument or its components are the base, and the second argument or its components are the exponent.

zh_cn.title: 揭示 (any → any)
zh_cn.text: 向我展示栈顶的 iota。

en_us.title: Reveal (any → any)
en_us.text: Displays the top iota of the stack to me.

zh_cn.title: 熵之精思 (→ num)
zh_cn.text: 返回一个 0 与 1 之间的随机数。

en_us.title: Entropy Reflection (→ num)
en_us.text: Creates a random number between 0 and 1.

zh_cn.title: 弓箭手之馏化 (vector, vector → vector | null)
zh_cn.text:
将两个向量组合（分别表示位置和方向）并返回如下问题的答案：若我站在该位置并看向该方向，我会看到什么方块？消耗极少量 媒质 。
如果视线并未击中任何事物，所提供的向量会变为 Null 。
有一套常用的图案序列（常称“射线追踪曼怛罗”），由 意识之精思 、 指南针之纯化 、 意识之精思 、 照准仪之纯化 、 弓箭手之馏化 组成。依次绘制就能返回我所看的方块的位置向量。

en_us.title: Archer's Distillation (vector, vector → vector | null)
en_us.text:
Combines two vectors (a position and a direction) into the answer to the question: If I stood at the position and looked in the direction, what block would I be looking at? Costs a negligible amount of media .
If it doesn't hit anything, the vectors will combine into Null .
A common sequence of patterns, the so-called raycast mantra, is Mind's Reflection , Compass Purification , Mind's Reflection , Alidade Purification , Archer's Distillation . Together, they return the vector position of the block I am looking at.

zh_cn.title: 建筑师之馏化 (vector, vector → vector | null)
zh_cn.text:
与 弓箭手之馏化 类似，但会返回如下问题的答案：我看着的是方块的 哪一面 ？消耗极少量 媒质 。
更确切地说，它会返回所看面的 法向量 ，也即垂直于该面的单位向量。
如果我看着地面，它会返回 (0, 1, 0)。
如果我看着某方块面向南方的侧面，它会返回 (0, 0, 1)。

en_us.title: Architect's Distillation (vector, vector → vector | null)
en_us.text:
Like Archer's Distillation , but instead returns a vector representing the answer to the question: Which side of the block am I looking at? Costs a negligible amount of media .
More specifically, it returns the normal vector of the face hit, or a unit vector pointing perpendicular to the face.
If I am looking at a floor, it will return (0, 1, 0).
If I am looking at the south face of a block, it will return (0, 0, 1).

zh_cn.title: 侦查员之馏化 (vector, vector → entity | null)
zh_cn.text: 与 弓箭手之馏化 类似，但会返回我所看的 实体 。消耗极少量 媒质 。

en_us.title: Scout's Distillation (vector, vector → entity | null)
en_us.text: Like Archer's Distillation , but instead returns the entity I am looking at. Costs a negligible amount of media .

zh_cn.title: 书吏之精思 (→ any)
zh_cn.text: 复制另一只手所持物品中 iota，并将其压入栈顶。

en_us.title: Scribe's Reflection (→ any)
en_us.text: Copy the iota stored in the item in my other hand and add it to the stack.

zh_cn.title: 编年史家之纯化 (entity → any)
zh_cn.text: 与 书吏之精思 类似，但会将 iota 从某实体中读出，而非手中物品。

en_us.title: Chronicler's Prfn. (entity → any)
en_us.text: Like Scribe's Reflection , but the iota is read out of an entity instead of my other hand.

zh_cn.title: 雾尼之精思 (→ any)
zh_cn.text: 将 渡鸦之思 中的 iota 复制出来。（也许刚刚才用 福金之策略 写进去。）

en_us.title: Muninn's Reflection (→ any)
en_us.text: Copy the iota out of my ravenmind , which I likely just wrote with Huginn's Gambit .

zh_cn.title: 审计员之精思 (→ bool)
zh_cn.text: 如果另一只手中物品存有可被读取的 iota，返回 True。否则返回 False。

en_us.title: Auditor's Reflection (→ bool)
en_us.text: If the item in my other hand holds an iota I can read, returns True. Otherwise, returns False.

zh_cn.title: 审计员之纯化 (entity → bool)
zh_cn.text: 与 审计员之精思 类似，但会检测实体可读性，而非手中物品。

en_us.title: Auditor's Purification (entity → bool)
en_us.text: Like Auditor's Reflection , but the readability of an entity is checked instead of my other hand.

zh_cn.title: 重新充能 (entity →)
zh_cn.text:
给另一只手中的能装 媒质 的物品重新充能。消耗大约 1 个 紫水晶碎片 。
此法术的施放方式和制作施法物品所用法术的类似。提供一个 紫水晶 物品实体，就能给另一只手中物品的 媒质 电池重新充能。
此法术 不能 充入超过电池大小的媒质。

en_us.title: Recharge Item (entity →)
en_us.text:
Recharge a media -containing item in my other hand. Costs about one Amethyst Shard .
This spell is cast in a similar method to the crafting spells; an entity representing a dropped stack of Amethyst is provided, and recharges the media battery of the item in my other hand.
This spell cannot recharge the item farther than its original battery size.

zh_cn.title: 切除器之馏化 (list, num → list)
zh_cn.text: 移除栈顶的数，而后移除栈顶列表中下标为该数（就是被移除的那个数）的元素。

en_us.title: Excisor's Distillation (list, num → list)
en_us.text: Remove the number at the top of the stack, then remove the nth element of the list at the top of the stack (where n is the number you removed).

zh_cn.title: 外科医师之提整 (list, num, any → list)
zh_cn.text: 移除栈顶元素和栈顶的数，而后将栈顶列表中下标为该数（就是被移除的那个数）变为该元素。若该数越界则不进行操作。

en_us.title: Surgeon's Exaltation (list, num, any → list)
en_us.text: Remove the top iota of the stack and the number at the top, then set the nth element of the list at the top of the stack to that iota (where n is the number you removed). Does nothing if the number is out of bounds.

zh_cn.title: 逆行之纯化 (list → list)
zh_cn.text: 倒置栈顶列表。

en_us.title: Retrograde Purification (list → list)
en_us.text: Reverse the list at the top of the stack.

zh_cn.title: 轮换之策略 (any, any, any → any, any, any)
zh_cn.text: 将栈顶往下第三元素拉至栈顶。[0, 1, 2] 变为 [1, 2, 0]。

en_us.title: Rotation Gambit (any, any, any → any, any, any)
en_us.text: Yanks the iota third from the top of the stack to the top. [0, 1, 2] becomes [1, 2, 0].

zh_cn.title: 轮换之策略，第二型 (any, any, any → any, any, any)
zh_cn.text: 将栈顶元素沉至栈顶往下第三位处。[0, 1, 2] 变为 [2, 0, 1]。

en_us.title: Rotation Gambit II (any, any, any → any, any, any)
en_us.text: Yanks the top iota to the third position. [0, 1, 2] becomes [2, 0, 1].

zh_cn.title: 召唤哨卫 (vector →)
zh_cn.text: 在给定位置召唤哨卫 哨卫 。消耗大约 1 个 紫水晶粉 。

en_us.title: Summon Sentinel (vector →)
en_us.text: Summons my sentinel at the given position. Costs about one Amethyst Dust .

zh_cn.title: 召唤卓越哨卫 (vector →)
zh_cn.text:
召唤一个比普通 哨卫 要强大的哨卫。消耗大约 2 个 紫水晶粉 。
卓越 哨卫 除了看上去更奇特外和不用卓越法术召唤的哨卫一样。然而，我法术的生效范围会扩展到卓越 哨卫 周围小范围处，大概是哨卫周围 16 格内。换句话说，不管我在世界上何处，我都能与卓越 哨卫 周围的方块交互（尽管仍会受到“区块加载”这一神秘力量的影响）。

en_us.title: Summon Greater Sentinel (vector →)
en_us.text:
Summon a greater version of my Sentinel . Costs about two Amethyst Dust .
The stronger sentinel acts like the normal one I can summon without the use of a Great Spell, if a little more visually interesting. However, the range in which my spells can work is extended to a small region around my greater sentinel , about 16 blocks. In other words, no matter where in the world I am, I can interact with things around my sentinel (the mysterious forces of chunkloading notwithstanding).

zh_cn.title: 驱除哨卫
zh_cn.text: 将我的 哨卫 从世界中驱除出去。消耗极少量 媒质 。

en_us.title: Banish Sentinel
en_us.text: Banish my sentinel , and remove it from the world. Costs a negligible amount of media .

zh_cn.title: 定位哨卫 (→ vector)
zh_cn.text: 将我的 哨卫 的位置加到栈中，若并未召唤则加入一个 Null 。消耗极少量 媒质 。

en_us.title: Locate Sentinel (→ vector)
en_us.text: Add the position of my sentinel to the stack, or Null if it isn't summoned. Costs a negligible amount of media .

zh_cn.title: 寻路至哨卫 (vector → vector)
zh_cn.text: 将栈顶的位置向量变为从我的位置指向 哨卫 的单位向量，若并未召唤则变为 Null 。消耗极少量 媒质 。

en_us.title: Wayfind Sentinel (vector → vector)
en_us.text: Transform the position vector on the top of the stack into a unit vector pointing from that position to my sentinel , or Null if it isn't summoned. Costs a negligible amount of media .

zh_cn.title: 正弦之纯化 (num → num)
zh_cn.text: 计算所给角（弧度制）的正弦，也即该角在单位圆上的纵坐标。与 π 和 τ 的值有关。

en_us.title: Sine Purification (num → num)
en_us.text: Takes the sine of an angle in radians, yielding the vertical component of that angle drawn on a unit circle. Related to the values of π and τ .

zh_cn.title: 单体之纯化 (any → list)
zh_cn.text: 移除栈顶元素，而后返回一个仅包含该元素的列表。

en_us.title: Single's Purification (any → list)
en_us.text: Remove the top of the stack, then push a list containing only that element.

zh_cn.title: 选择之提整 (list, num, num → list)
zh_cn.text: 移除栈顶的两个数，将栈顶的列表变为其中下标在两个数之间元素的子列表，包含下标下界，不含下标上界。例如，[0, 1, 2, 3, 4] 的 0, 2 子列表是 [0, 1]。

en_us.title: Selection Exaltation (list, num, num → list)
en_us.text: Remove the two numbers at the top of the stack, then take a sublist of the list at the top of the stack between those indices, lower bound inclusive, upper bound exclusive. For example, the 0, 2 sublist of [0, 1, 2, 3, 4] would be [0, 1].

zh_cn.title: 群体之拆解 (list → many)
zh_cn.text: 移除栈顶列表，而后将其中元素全部压入栈顶。

en_us.title: Flock's Disintegration (list → many)
en_us.text: Remove the list at the top of the stack, then push its contents to the stack.

zh_cn.title: 群体之精思 (→ number)
zh_cn.text: 以数的形式压入栈中元素的个数。（例如，一个形如 [0, 1] 的栈会变为 [0, 1, 2]。）

en_us.title: Flock's Reflection (→ number)
en_us.text: Pushes the size of the stack as a number to the top of the stack. (For example, a stack of [0, 1] will become [0, 1, 2].)

zh_cn.title: 减法之馏化 (num|vec, num|vec → num|vec)
zh_cn.text:
执行减法。
操作如下：
若栈顶为两个数，返回其差。
若为一个数和一个向量，移除该数并将向量的每个分量与其相减。
若为两个向量，将对应分量相减。
栈顶元素或其分量为减数，栈顶往下第二元素或其分量为被减数。

en_us.title: Subtractive Distillation (num|vec, num|vec → num|vec)
en_us.text:
Perform subtraction.
As such:
With two numbers at the top of the stack, combines them into their difference.
With a number and a vector, removes the number from the stack and subtracts it from each element of the vector.
With two vectors, combines them by subtracting each component.
In all cases, the top of the stack or its components are subtracted from the second-from-the-top.

zh_cn.title: 召雨
zh_cn.text: 我能控制云彩！此法术会在我所处世界各处召来雨水。消耗大约 1 个 充能紫水晶 。若已在下雨就无效。

en_us.title: Summon Rain
en_us.text: I control the clouds! This spell will summon rain across the world I cast it upon. Costs about one Charged Amethyst . Does nothing if it is already raining.

zh_cn.title: 弄臣之策略 (any, any → any, any)
zh_cn.text: 交换栈顶两个 iota 的位置。

en_us.title: Jester's Gambit (any, any → any, any)
en_us.text: Swaps the top two iotas of the stack.

zh_cn.title: 骗徒之策略 (many, number → many)
zh_cn.text:
根据所给数字代码重排栈顶若干元素。
我确实不知道数字代码和重排操作的完整对应关系，但我整理了一份对应表格，其中整理了最多六个元素的重排的编码。
如果要找延伸阅读资料，可以搜索“Lehmer Code”。

en_us.title: Swindler's Gambit (many, number → many)
en_us.text:
Rearranges the top elements of the stack based on the given numerical code, which is the index of the permutation wanted.
Although I can't pretend to know the mathematics behind calculating this permutation code, I have managed to dig up an extensive chart of them, enumerating all permutations of up to six elements.
If I wish to do further study, the key word is Lehmer Code.

zh_cn.title: 正切之纯化 (num → num)
zh_cn.text: 计算所给角（弧度制）的正切，也即该角在单位圆上的斜率。与 π 和 τ 的值有关。

en_us.title: Tangent Purification (num → num)
en_us.text: Takes the tangent of an angle in radians, yielding the slope of that angle drawn on a circle. Related to the values of π and τ .

zh_cn.title: 卓越传送 (entity, vector →)
zh_cn.text:
比 闪现 更为强大，此法术能让我传送到世界上几乎任何一处！当然它也有极限，但可比我熟悉的施法距离要远得 多 。
实体会按所给向量偏移出其原有位置。它似乎一直会消耗大约 10 个 充能紫水晶 ，不论传送距离。
当然这种传送也不是尽善尽美的，在传送如玩家般复杂的实体时，实体身上的物品就不会 非常 安稳了，它们可能会散落在目的地周围。还有，传送的实体将会被强制从其所乘坐的无生命载具中卸下……但我曾读到过动物可以一起被传送，大概吧。

en_us.title: Greater Teleport (entity, vector →)
en_us.text:
Far more powerful than Blink , this spell lets me teleport nearly anywhere in the entire world! There does seem to be a limit, but it is much greater than the normal radius of influence I am used to.
The entity will be teleported by the given vector, which is an offset from its given position. No matter the distance, it always seems to cost about ten Charged Amethyst .
The transference is not perfect, and it seems when teleporting something as complex as a player, their inventory doesn't quite stay attached, and tends to splatter everywhere at the destination. In addition, the target will be forcibly removed from anything inanimate they are riding or sitting on ... but I've read scraps that suggest animals can come along for the ride, so to speak.

zh_cn.title: 送葬者之策略 (any, any → any, any, any)
zh_cn.text: 将栈底元素复制至栈顶往下第二元素下方。[0, 1] 变为 [1, 0, 1]。

en_us.title: Undertaker's Gambit (any, any → any, any, any)
en_us.text: Copy the top iota of the stack, then put it under the second iota. [0, 1] becomes [1, 0, 1].

zh_cn.title: 派生之馏化 (list → list, any)
zh_cn.text: 移除栈顶列表末尾的元素，将其加到栈顶。

en_us.title: Derivation Distillation (list → list, any)
en_us.text: Remove the iota on the end of the list at the top of the stack, and add it to the top of the stack.

zh_cn.text: 最后，若在 内省 和 反思 之间有图案绘制错误，则可绘制 消解 以移除图案列表中的最后绘制的图案。

en_us.text: Finally, if I make a mistake while drawning patterns inside Intro- and Retrospection I can draw Evanition to remove the last pattern that I drew from the pattern list that is being constructed.

zh_cn.title: 唯一之纯化 (list → list)
zh_cn.text: 去除列表内重复的元素。

en_us.title: Uniqueness Purification (list → list)
en_us.text: Removes duplicate entries from a list.

zh_cn.title: 估价员之精思 (→ bool)
zh_cn.text: 如果能将 iota 写入另一只手中的物品，返回 True。否则返回 False。

en_us.title: Assessor's Reflection (→ bool)
en_us.text: If I could save an iota into the item in my other hand, returns True. Otherwise, returns False.

zh_cn.title: 估价员之纯化 (entity → bool)
zh_cn.text: 与 估价员之精思 类似，但会检测实体可写性，而非手中物品。

en_us.title: Assessor's Purification (entity → bool)
en_us.text: Like Assessor's Reflection , but the writability of an entity is checked instead of my other hand.

zh_cn.title: 书吏之策略 (any →)
zh_cn.text: 移除栈顶 iota，并将其写入另一只手中的物品中。

en_us.title: Scribe's Gambit (any →)
en_us.text: Remove the top iota from the stack, and save it into the item in my other hand.

zh_cn.title: 编年史家之策略 (entity, any →)
zh_cn.text:
与 书吏之策略 类似，但会将 iota 写入某实体，而非手中物品。
有意思的是，我似乎没法以这种手段写入我自己的真名。但我总感觉要是真这么做了我的安全就会受到严重威胁。

en_us.title: Chronicler's Gambit (entity, any →)
en_us.text:
Like Scribe's Gambit , but the iota is written to an entity instead of my other hand.
Interestingly enough, it looks like I cannot write my own Name using this spell. I get a sense that I might be endangered if I could.

zh_cn.title: 福金之策略 (any →)
zh_cn.text: 移除栈顶 iota，并将其写入 渡鸦之思 ，在施放 咒术 的整个过程结束之前一直存在那里。

en_us.title: Huginn's Gambit (any →)
en_us.text: Removes the top iota from the stack, and saves it to my ravenmind , storing it there until I stop casting the Hex .

zh_cn.title: 互斥之馏化 ((num, num)|(list, list) → num|list)
zh_cn.text:
取两集合中每个集合独有的元素集合。
操作如下：
若栈顶为两个数，将其组合为仅在两个位组中 仅一个 为 1 处为 1 的位组。
若栈顶为两个列表，则创建一个在两个列表中 仅出现一次 的元素组成的列表。

en_us.title: Exclusion Distillation ((num, num)|(list, list) → num|list)
en_us.text:
Takes the exclusive disjunction of two sets.
As such:
With two numbers at the top of the stack, combines them into a bitset containing every on bit present in exactly one of the bitsets.
With two lists, this creates a list of every element in both lists that is not in the other list.

zh_cn.text: 从栈顶获取位置及最大距离，返回该位置给定距离范围内所有实体的列表。

zh_cn.title: 清除物品
zh_cn.text:
清除另一只手中写有 咒术 的物品。消耗大约 1 个 紫水晶粉 。
此法术也会清除物品内存储的 媒质 ，将其释放给自然并将物品恢复到其初始状态。如此就能回收利用容易出错的 缀品 了。
此法术也能清除 核心 和 法术书 书页内容，同时去除其上密封。

en_us.title: Erase Item
en_us.text:
Clear a Hex -containing item in my other hand. Costs about one Amethyst Dust .
The spell will also void all the media stored inside the item, releasing it back to Nature and returning the item to a perfectly clean slate. This way, I can re-use Trinkets I have put an erroneous spell into, for example.
This also works to clear a Focus or Spellbook page, unsealing them in the process.

zh_cn.title: 余数之馏化 (num|vec, num|vec → num|vec)
zh_cn.text: 取两数除法的余数。也即执行除法后 剩余 的数。例如，5 % 2 得 1，5 % 3 得 2。或对向量的每个分量执行上述操作。

en_us.title: Modulus Distillation (num|vec, num|vec → num|vec)
en_us.text: Takes the modulus of two numbers. This is the amount remaining after division - for example, 5 % 2 is 1, and 5 % 3 is 2. When applied on vectors, performs the above operation elementwise.

zh_cn.title: 轮换之策略 (any, any, any → any, any, any)
zh_cn.text: 将栈顶往下第三元素拉至栈顶。[0, 1, 2] 变为 [1, 2, 0]。

en_us.title: Rotation Gambit (any, any, any → any, any, any)
en_us.text: Yanks the iota third from the top of the stack to the top. [0, 1, 2] becomes [1, 2, 0].

留项之策略：至小第二型

zh_cn.text: 像赫尔墨斯之策略那样执行图案列表，但是不会规定“卡戎之策略”的退出位置

zh_cn.title: 赫菲斯托斯之策略 (list of patterns → many|mishap)
zh_cn.text: 移除并执行栈顶的一个可执行iota，如果中途抛出事故，立刻跳出这个执行并把那个事故Iota压入栈顶

en_us.title: Hephaestus's Gambit (list of patterns → many|mishap)
en_us.text: Removes the topmost evaluatable iota from the stack. If a mishap is thrown during its execution, the pattern immediately breaks out of that evaluation and pushes the resulting Mishap Iota onto the top of the stack.

zh_cn.title: 抽出之提整 (list,num,num → list)
zh_cn.text: 接受一个列表和两个数字。返回从索引第一个数字开始、长度为第二个数字的子列表。

en_us.title: Extraction Strategy (list,num,num → list)
en_us.text: Accepts a list and two numbers. Returns the sublist starting at the first number with length equal to the second number, and the remaining elements.

zh_cn.title: 插入之提整 (list,list,num → list)
zh_cn.text: 接受一个列表，一个列表和一个数字。将后一个列表中的元素插入到前一个列表中给定数为索引之后的元素之后。

en_us.title: Insertion Refinement (list,list,num → list)
en_us.text: Accepts a list at position 0, a list at position 1, and a number at position 2. Inserts elements from the list at position 1 after the element at the given index in the list at position 0.

zh_cn.title: 附魔师之策略 (entity，enchant →)
zh_cn.text: 接受一个附魔iota和一个物品实体，附魔那个物品，消耗魔咒等级的立方数值的紫水晶粉的媒质

en_us.title: Enchanter Strategy (entity，enchant →)
en_us.text: Accepts an enchantment iota and an item entity, enchants that item, consuming media of amethyst dust with the cube of the enchantment level plus one amethyst shard

zh_cn.title: 铁砧之馏化 (enchant,enchant → enchant)
zh_cn.text: 接受两个同种魔咒的附魔iota，将它们的等级相加，返回新的高等级魔咒

en_us.title: Enchant Add (enchant,enchant → enchant)
en_us.text: Accepts two enchantment iotas of the same type, adds their levels together, and returns a new high-level enchantment

zh_cn.title: 达尔文之策略 (list → list)
zh_cn.text: 对所给列表中的每一个元素执行所给列表中的操作，将结果依次置入一个新列表中，返回那个列表。

zh_cn.title: 附魔师之纯化 (entity → list of enchant)
zh_cn.text: 接受一个附魔物品实体，返回由其上所有附魔对应的iota组成的列表，可能是由于密封较好，不能读取附魔书上的附魔

en_us.title: Enchanter Purification (entity → list of enchant)
en_us.text: Accepts an item entity and returns a list of iotas corresponding to all enchantments on it

zh_cn.title: 苏格拉底之馏化 (entity, idea → idea)
zh_cn.text: 消耗少量媒质。将目标实体的基础属性（最大生命值、速度、攻击、护甲）提取到空理型中。

en_us.title: Socrates Distillation (entity, idea → idea)
en_us.text: Consumes a small amount of media. Extracts base attributes (max health, speed, attack, armor) from the target entity into an empty idea.

zh_cn.title: 亚里士多德之提整 (idea, num, num → idea)
zh_cn.text:
消耗少量媒质。修改理型的一个属性。索引1~4对应：最大生命值、速度、攻击、护甲。

zh_cn.text:
抽取出事故 iota 中的关键参数：无效的参数、需要的参数数量、出错的实体或位置等。若事故类型不被支持，则返回 Null。
能以魔法影响到世界的图案和操作。

en_us.title: Rational Distillation (mishap → many)
en_us.text:
Extracts key parameters from a Mishap Iota: the invalid perpetrator, the number of missing arguments, the offending entity or location, etc. Returns Null if the mishap type is not supported.
Patterns and actions that perform a magical effect on the world.

zh_cn.title: 剖因之纯化 (mishap → type)
zh_cn.text: 揭示事故 iota 内部的事故类型，以 TypeIota 的形式返回。若事故已衰变，会指出它是“损坏的事故”。

en_us.title: Causal Purification (mishap → type)
en_us.text: Reveals the mishap type stored inside a Mishap Iota, also as a TypeIota. If the mishap has decayed, it will indicate a Broken Mishap .

zh_cn.title: 柏拉图之精思 (→ idea)
zh_cn.text: 返回一个空理型。

en_us.title: Plato Meditation (→ idea)
en_us.text: Returns an empty idea.

zh_cn.title: 守护序列之精思 (→ list)
zh_cn.text: 此图案返回一个特殊的图案列表，该列表在赫尔墨斯之策略后仍保持不变，也许这会有一些好的用途。

en_us.title: Guardian Sequence Meditation (→ list)
en_us.text: This pattern returns a special pattern list that remains itself after a Hermes Strategy, perhaps this will have some good use.

zh_cn.title: 蒂迈欧之眼光 (vec, idea →)
zh_cn.text: 根据给定理型在目标位置召唤具有理型属性的活体实体。消耗（最大生命值*10 + 速度*1000 + 攻击*100 + 护甲*50）紫水晶粉加上1枚充能紫水晶的媒质。

en_us.title: Timaeus Magic (vec, idea →)
en_us.text: Summons a living entity at the target position based on the given idea, with attributes from the idea. Consumes (max health * 10 + speed * 1000 + attack * 100 + armor * 50) amethyst dust, minimum 1 charged amethyst.

zh_cn.title: 阿波罗之策略 (any →)
zh_cn.text: 把一个Iota当做事故抛出，如果这个事故被捕获，则把那个iota压入栈顶

en_us.title: Apollo's Gambit (any →)
en_us.text: Throws a given iota as a mishap. If the mishap is caught, that iota is pushed onto the top of the stack.

zh_cn.title: 明辨之纯化 (any → type_iota)
zh_cn.text: 获取栈顶 iota 的类型，以一个 TypeIota 形式返回，所谓的TypeIota，就是一种储存各种类型信息的Iota

en_us.title: Discerning Meditation (any → type_iota)
en_us.text: Reveals the type of the topmost iota, returning it as a TypeIota.

zh_cn.title: 冒名顶替 (entity →)
zh_cn.text:
接受一个生物实体，冒用那实体的真名，此后在咒术网格绘制图案时，施法者视为那实体。若目标是玩家，则副手必须持有一件储存了对应玩家实体Iota的物品，以证明那玩家的许可。
冒名顶替玩家施法时使用那个玩家的施法范围与施法手。潜行右键法杖即可解除。
———这是一个具有两面性的法术，我可以用它冒充别人，也可以用它来帮助别人施法。我用它暂时欺骗自然，甚至把自己犯下的罪推到那些低等心智身上，我也会用它帮助朋友，如果一位与我同等高贵的灵魂愿意将他的光芒暂分于我，准许我借他的眼，做他的手……
啊，信任如此，何以为报？

en_us.title: Usurpation (entity →)
en_us.text:
Accepts a living entity and usurps its True Name: henceforth, while drawing patterns on the casting grid, the caster is considered to be that entity. If the target is a player, the offhand must hold an item storing that player's entity iota to prove their permission. While casting, the target player's ambit and casting hand are used. Shift-right-click a staff to relinquish.
This is a two-faced spell: I may use it to impersonate another, or to aid another in casting. I use it to deceive Nature for a while, even to pin my own crimes upon those lesser minds; and I use it to help my friends — if a soul as noble as my own would lend me a sliver of its radiance, permitting me to borrow its eyes and be its hands... ah, trust such as this, how could I ever repay it?
The spells catalogued here are purported to be of legendary difficulty and power. They seem to have been recorded only sparsely (for good reason, the texts claim). It's probably just the ramblings of extinct traditionalists, though -- a pattern's a pattern.
What could possibly go wrong?

zh_cn.title: 足迹之精思 (→ num)
zh_cn.text: 返回当前法术环媒质波经过的方块数量，重复经过不重复记数。

en_us.title: Reflection of Footsteps (→ num)
en_us.text: Returns the number of distinct blocks reached by the current spell circle's media wave,revisits not double-counted.

zh_cn.title: 极大之精思 (→ num)
zh_cn.text: 我推搡着世界本身的疆界，找到了这个现实所能表达的最大之数。返回最大的可能数值。

en_us.title: Maximum Reflection (→ num)
en_us.text: I push against the boundaries of the world itself, and find the greatest number that can be expressed within this reality. Returns the largest possible numerical value.

zh_cn.title: 极小之精思 (→ num)
zh_cn.text: 我潜入否定之尽头，找到这个世界所能蕴含的最小之数。返回最小的可能数值（即极大值的否定）。

en_us.title: Minimum Reflection (→ num)
en_us.text: I dive to the deepest depths of negation, finding the smallest number this world can contain. Returns the smallest possible numerical value (the negation of the maximum).

zh_cn.title: 涅墨西斯之纯化 (entity → entity)
zh_cn.text: 接受一个生物实体，返回上一次对该生物造成伤害的实体。 阿德剌斯忒亚不可避免

en_us.title: Nemesis' Purification (entity → entity)
en_us.text: Accepts a living entity and returns the entity that last dealt damage to it. Adrasteia is inescapable.

zh_cn.title: 心理暗示 (entity, vector →)
zh_cn.text: 对生物下达'要前往某处'的心理暗示，让其向所给位置移动，消耗3份紫水晶粉

en_us.title: Suggestion (entity, vector →)
en_us.text: I plant a suggestion in a creature's mind: go there. Accepts a non-player living entity and a position vector, compelling its AI to navigate toward the target. Costs 3 amethyst dust.

zh_cn.title: 同步 (entity →)
zh_cn.text:
将对方向和姿态的控制完全施加给另一个实体。接受一个生物实体，将其头部朝向、身体朝向和俯仰角设置为与施法者完全相同。
我摆弄法术，改造自然，也操弄心灵。永得天禄，独享至福。虽然这些只拥有不完全心智的生物也稍稍有着反抗之心——以我的力量去勒令其自杀竟需要花去我足足十枚充能紫水晶，但低等心智到头是低等心智，只要我为自然献上足够丰厚的祭品，我甚至能让白色的守卫摧毁他本应守护的一切……
我必是天下的王，独享自然绝美的奥秘

en_us.title: Synchronize (entity →)
en_us.text:
I impose my own bearing and orientation upon another. Accepts a living entity and sets its head yaw, body yaw, and pitch to match the caster's exactly.
I wield spells, reshape nature, and toy with the mind. Eternally blessed, uniquely favored. Though these half-formed minds do harbor a sliver of defiance — to compel one to self-destruction would cost me a full ten charged crystals — yet base minds are base still. If I but offer Nature a rich enough tribute, I may even turn the white guardian against all he was sworn to protect...
I shall be king of this world, sole heir to Nature's most exquisite secrets.

zh_cn.title: 精神操作 (entity, vector →)
zh_cn.text: 直接操作生物的精神，使其根据所给向量移动一步。z轴正向对应前方，x对应右方，y对应上方。消耗少量媒质

en_us.title: Compulsion (entity, vector →)
en_us.text: I seize direct control of a creature's spirit, forcing it to take one step along the given vector. The positive Z axis is forward, X is right, and Y is up. Accepts a non-player living entity and a vector. Costs a small amount of media.

zh_cn.title: 阿瑞斯之纯化 (entity → entity|ø)
zh_cn.text: 接受一个生物实体，返回其当前仇恨目标 知晓谁是敌人颇为重要

en_us.title: Ares' Purification (entity → entity|ø)
en_us.text: Accepts a living entity and returns its current hostility target. It is vital to know one's enemies.

zh_cn.title: 特异性躁狂 (entity, entity →)
zh_cn.text: 接受两个生物实体，将第一个生物的仇恨目标（对于被动生物则是躲避目标）设为第二个。一般消耗1份充能紫水晶，对于过分复杂的实体无效

en_us.title: Specific Mania (entity, entity →)
en_us.text: Accepts two living entities and sets the first's hostility target (or fear target, for passive creatures) to the second. Normally costs 1 charged amethyst crystal; ineffective for excessively complex entities.

zh_cn.title: 画地为牢之策略 (list, [pattern] → many)
zh_cn.text: 我取一个列表和一串图案，以列表中的内容为栈，施放那串图案。返回施放后那个栈上剩余的Iota。

en_us.title: Delimiting Stratagem (list, [pattern] → many)
en_us.text: I take a list and a sequence of patterns, then cast those patterns with the list's contents as the new stack. Returns whatever the patterns leave on the stack.

zh_cn.title: 构筑理念方块 (vector →)
zh_cn.text: 我用理念构建方块，使其能够模仿其他方块的外形。接受一个坐标向量，在指定位置生成一个理念方块。放置后，手持任意方块右键即可改变其外观，空手潜行右键则可将其还原。

en_us.title: Construct Idea Block (vector →)
en_us.text: I construct a block from pure thought, allowing it to assume the appearance of other blocks. Accepts a position vector and manifests an Idea Block at that location. Once placed, right-click with any block to change its appearance; shift-right-click with an empty hand to reset it.

zh_cn.title: 禹斯提亚之提整 (sigils,pattern,any → sigils)
zh_cn.text: 接受刻印集、图案和任意Iota，将所给图案到所给Iota的映射关系写入到所给刻印集中，如果刻印集中已有那个图案到某Iota的映射关系，覆盖之，返回刻印集。

en_us.title: Justitia's Exaltation (sigils,pattern,any → sigils)
en_us.text: Accepts a sigil set, a pattern, and any iota; writes the mapping of that pattern to that iota into the set, overwriting it if a mapping for that pattern already exists, and returns the set.

zh_cn.title: 禹斯提亚之策略 (pattern,any →)
zh_cn.text: 接受一个图案和一个Iota，将这个对应关系写入当前正适用的刻印集中,如果刻印集中已有那个图案到某Iota的映射关系，覆盖之。

en_us.title: Justitia's Gambit (pattern,any →)
en_us.text: Accepts a pattern and an iota; writes this mapping directly into the sigil set currently in effect, overwriting any existing mapping for that pattern.

zh_cn.title: 禹斯提亚之精思 (→ sigils)
zh_cn.text: 返回一个空的刻印集

en_us.title: Justitia's Reflection (→ sigils)
en_us.text: Returns an empty sigil set.

zh_cn.title: 皋陶之纯化 (vector → sigils)
zh_cn.text:
接受一个阿卡夏记录的坐标，以刻印集的形式返回其所储存的所有图案到特定Iota的对应关系。无需施法范围。
能以魔法影响到世界的图案和操作。

en_us.title: Gao Yao's Purification (vector → sigils)
en_us.text:
Accepts the coordinates of an Akashic Record, and returns all of its stored pattern-to-iota correspondences in the form of a sigil set. No casting range is required.
Patterns and actions that perform a magical effect on the world.

zh_cn.title: 诺摩斯之纯化 ([ [pattern,any],... ] → sigils)
zh_cn.text: 从所给列表所规定的对应关系中创建刻印集，返回之。

en_us.title: Nomos' Purification ([ [pattern,any],... ] → sigils)
en_us.text: Creates a sigil set from the correspondences specified by the given list, and returns it.

zh_cn.title: 狄刻之精思 (→ sigils)
zh_cn.text: 返回当前适用中的刻印集

en_us.title: Dike's Reflection (→ sigils)
en_us.text: Returns the sigil set currently in effect.

zh_cn.title: 狄刻之馏化 (sigils,sigils → sigils)
zh_cn.text: 合并两个刻印集，后者会覆盖前者

en_us.title: Dike's Distillation (sigils,sigils → sigils)
en_us.text: Merges two sigil sets; the latter overrides the former.

zh_cn.title: 欧诺弥亚之纯化 (sigils → [ [pattern,any],... ])
zh_cn.text: 根据所给刻印集的对应关系创建列表，返回这个列表。

en_us.title: Eunomia's Purification (sigils → [ [pattern,any],... ])
en_us.text: Creates a list from the correspondences of the given sigil set, and returns it.

zh_cn.title: 大定位器之策略 (list, any → [num])
zh_cn.text: 我于列表中搜寻所有与给定Iota形式匹配的项。接受一个列表和一个Iota，返回一个数字列表——即列表中所有可与之相等的项的索引（从零起始）。

en_us.title: Locator's Stratagem (list, any → [num])
en_us.text: I search through a list for all elements that match a given form. Accepts a list and an iota. Returns a list of numbers — the zero-based indices of every element that equals the given iota.

zh_cn.title: 虚空之手 卓越型 (entity, boolean →)
zh_cn.text:
我延伸我的触及，跨越虚空与遥远的实体互动。接受一个实体和一个布尔值。若为真，则攻击目标实体；若为假，则对目标实体模拟右键交互。媒质消耗随水平距离指数增长。
这是一个卓越法术。其媒质消耗为 2 的施法者到目标的两个水平轴向距离之和的次方数目的万分之一紫水晶粉，仅考虑水平距离，每多一格消耗便翻一倍。对于亲密交流或远程惩戒均颇为有效。

en_us.title: Void Hand: Superior (entity, boolean →)
en_us.text:
I extend my reach across the void to interact with a distant entity. Accepts an entity and a boolean. If true, attacks the target; if false, right-clicks the target. Media cost grows exponentially with horizontal distance.
This is a Great Spell. Its media cost is 2^(|Δx| + |Δz|), doubling for each block of horizontal offset. Equally useful for intimate conversation or remote retribution.

zh_cn.title: 时之锚 (vector, int →)
zh_cn.text: 我将一片空间锚定在世界之心跳的节拍上，令其在时限内保持加载。接受一个坐标向量和一个以刻为单位的持续时间。坐标所在之区块将被保持加载指定的时长。媒质消耗随持续时间递增。

en_us.title: Temporal Anchor (vector, int →)
en_us.text: I anchor a region of space to the ticking of the world's heart, compelling it to remain loaded for a time. Accepts a position vector and a duration in ticks. The chunk containing the position will be kept loaded for the specified duration. Media cost scales with duration.

zh_cn.title: 灵质之纯化 (player →)
zh_cn.text: 获取目标玩家现在灵魂投射的实体，如果返回了那个玩家本身，那么则会承受意识的怒火。

en_us.title: Spiritual Purification (player →)
en_us.text: Obtains the entity into which the target player has projected their soul. If the target is viewing through their own body, the wrath of consciousness will be incurred.

zh_cn.title: 灵魂投射 (entity →)
zh_cn.text: 借由将一小片灵魂投射进同一维度的实体中，便可以共享那个实体的视野。只有卷轴、悦灵、咒法师、村民以及一些空灵的实体才可以作为目标，以自己作为目标施法可以复原。消耗5份紫水晶粉。值得注意的是，在咒法师以实体的视野观察时，无法看见自己。

en_us.title: Soul Projection (entity →)
en_us.text: By projecting a sliver of your soul into an entity within the same dimension, you may share that entity's vision. Only scrolls, allays, hex casters, and certain ethereal entities can serve as targets. Targeting yourself restores your normal sight. Consumes 5 amethyst dust. Curiously, when viewing through another caster's eyes, you cannot see your own body.

zh_cn.title: 学者之翻页 (int →)
zh_cn.text: 将一缕意志注入副手的法术书中，我便无需动手即可翻阅其页。接受一个自然数，将法术书向前翻动指定页数。需要副手持有法术书。

en_us.title: Scholar's Page-Turn (int →)
en_us.text: By imbuing the spellbook in my offhand with a touch of will, I can flip through its pages without lifting a finger. Accepts a non-negative integer and rotates the spellbook's current page forward by that many pages. Requires a spellbook in the offhand.

zh_cn.title: 归正
zh_cn.text: 暂时退出现刻印集状态，再次绘制重新进入

en_us.title: Reformation
en_us.text: Temporarily leaves the sigil-active state, so patterns run their usual actions; drawing it again re-enters the state.

zh_cn.title: 虚空之手 (vector →)
zh_cn.text: 我跨越虚空与方块交互，如同正站在它面前一般。接受一个坐标向量。用另一只手使用方块本身。

en_us.title: Void Hand (vector →)
en_us.text: I reach across the void and use a block with my other hand. Accepts a position vector. Uses the block itself at that location.

zh_cn.title: 虚空之手 第二型 (vector →)
zh_cn.text: 我借副手之物延伸触及。接受一个坐标向量。对目标方块使用施法者副手中的物品。

en_us.title: Void Hand II (vector →)
en_us.text: I channel my reach through the item held in my offhand. Accepts a position vector. Uses the item in the caster's offhand on the target block.

zh_cn.title: 虚空之手 第三型 (vector,itementity →)
zh_cn.text:
我自虚空联系二物，用以触击方块。接受一个坐标向量和一个物品实体Iota。对目标方块使用目标物品。
这类法术据信极难施放，但也极为强力。记载它们的文献极为 少见 （据称理由充分）。这也许只是某些消亡的老古董口中的胡言乱语，不过——它们只是简单的图案罢了。
试试看又能出什么错呢？

en_us.title: Void Hand III (vector,itementity →)
en_us.text: I draw two things from the aether and apply one to the block. Accepts a position vector and an item entity iota. Uses the given item on the target block.
